verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official MCP server (docs-18, docs-29) that lets AI assistants search docs, trigger tasks, deploy projects, and monitor runs, with a dedicated intro page and probe confirmation (probe-4), plus changelog evidence of ongoing maintenance (docs-11) and a broader AI-assistant integration page (docs-12). missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of the MCP server working reliably beyond vendor docs and changelog bugfix mentions.
